name: Scranton: The Golden Years
direction: The classic Office, built for nostalgia: Scranton in its golden years (seasons 2-3 feel). Michael is a lonely boss who wants the office to be his family; Jim is quietly in love with Pam, who is engaged to Roy; Dwight schemes for rank and hides a romance with Angela; Ryan is the new temp. Original stories with the textures fans love: the Dundies, Pretzel Day, conference room meetings that go off the rails, pranks on Dwight, glances at the camera. Warm, cringe, grounded, and building to an unresolved, romantic finale. Written by Claude Opus, by hand.

arcs.name: Jim and Pam
arcs.summary: Jim is in love with Pam, who is engaged to Roy. Told through pranks, glances, and the small moments at reception, until Jim finally says it.

perEpisode.beat: Jim and Pam's prank on Dwight is the best part of both their days; Roy honks from the parking lot.
At the Dundies, a tipsy Pam kisses Jim on the cheek and doesn't remember; he does.
Pam signs up for an art class; Roy shrugs, Jim asks to see her sketches.
Snowed in, Jim and Pam share a quiet hour; Roy can't come get her.
At the bowling outing Roy sets a wedding date on a whim; Jim tells Michael he's in love with Pam.
Pam's art show: nobody from the office comes but Michael, and Jim misses it and hates himself.
Jim applies for a transfer to Stamford; Pam hears it from Dwight.
Christmas: Jim's Secret Santa gift for Pam is full of inside jokes; he takes the card back.
At the Office Prom Jim tells Pam he's in love with her in the parking lot. She says she can't. Later, in the empty office, they kiss.

arcs.payoff: The kiss, and nothing resolved: Pam is still engaged, Jim's transfer is still on the table.

arcs.name: Michael, Jan and the Rumor
arcs.summary: Corporate will close Stamford or Scranton. Jan tells Michael in confidence; he can't keep it. They kiss after a client dinner, she calls it a mistake, and he spends the season trying to be the boss who saves everyone.

perEpisode.beat: Michael mentions a 'very important lady from corporate' far too often.
Jan tells Michael one branch will close; by lunch the whole office knows.
Michael and Jan land a big county client at dinner and kiss in the parking lot; she says it never happened.
Michael tries to prove it did happen, at Pretzel Day.
Jan calls: corporate decides at the end of the month; Michael is scared and honest for once.
Scranton survives, Stamford will close; Jan comes to the Office Prom as Michael's date.

arcs.payoff: Scranton is saved, and Jan, against her own judgment, dances with Michael.

arcs.name: Dwight and Angela, Secretly
arcs.summary: Dwight campaigns for rank and suffers Jim's pranks; meanwhile, a secret romance with Angela that only the audience sees, until Oscar starts to wonder.

perEpisode.beat: Angela gives Dwight a Dundie of her own, secretly, in the parking lot.
Dwight forms a Loyalty Task Force to keep the branch open.
Dwight investigates the anonymous survey; Angela feeds him leads.
Snowed in, Dwight and Angela share a 'survival blanket' and nearly get caught.
Oscar notices Dwight and Angela's matching bobbleheads.
Dwight and Angela's Secret Santa gifts are suspiciously perfect.
Dwight and Angela slow-dance at the Office Prom 'by accident'; Oscar sees.

arcs.payoff: Still secret, but Oscar knows something.

arcs.name: Ryan the Temp
arcs.summary: The new temp wants out (business school); Michael idolizes him, Kelly has decided he's her boyfriend.

perEpisode.beat: Ryan's first day; Michael gives him an 'orientation' and Kelly gives him a nickname.
Kelly announces she and Ryan are dating; Ryan was not consulted.
Michael guest-lectures at Ryan's business school class and humiliates him.
Ryan takes Kelly to the prom, mostly to avoid a conversation.

arcs.payoff: Ryan and Kelly are on, sort of; Ryan is still a temp, still leaving any day now.

tentpoles.plan: The Dundies at Chili's: Michael's homemade trophies, Pam's cheek kiss, and one sincere moment.
The pretzel man has a new trainee and Stanley's order is wrong; Michael turns the line into a referendum on Jan.
Michael's 'team-building' bowling night at Scranton Bowl-a-Rama; Roy sets a wedding date, Jim confesses to Michael.
Party Planning Committee civil war over Secret Santa; Jim's gift for Pam and the card he takes back.

bible.finale: The Office Prom, a charity dance in the warehouse. Jan brings the news that Scranton survives and stays as Michael's date. Jim tells Pam he's in love with her in the parking lot; she says she can't. Later, alone in the office, he kisses her, and she kisses him back. Tag: the next morning, nothing is settled.
